hero.body: Every service has clear steps and a price we confirm with you before we start. Message us on WhatsApp, or request a service from here.

consult.title: Help choosing a build
consult.body: Tell us what you'll use the PC for and your budget, and we'll recommend a build and explain why we picked each part.
steps: You send us the use and budget
We send one or two recommendations
You choose, and we adjust if you like
consult.message: I'd like help choosing a build.

build.title: Assembly
build.body: Whether the parts come from us or from you, we assemble the PC, tidy the cables, install Windows and drivers, and hand it over ready. If a part should be swapped, we suggest an alternative.
steps: You choose the parts or bring them
build.message: I'd like to request an assembly service.

test.title: Part check
test.body: Have a part and not sure about its condition? Bring it and we'll stress-test it and give you a report with the result. If you sell it to us or buy a replacement from us, the check fee is deducted.
steps: Bring the part to Agami or ship it
Report with the result and photos
